title: Trump Secures Voluntary AI Pact to Prevent China From Overtaking US
summary:
Industry executives committed to a 'morally binding' framework for self-policing the development of artificial intelligence during a meeting at the White House. President Trump's approach favors voluntary safeguards over mandatory legislation, with the administration arguing that rules stricter than self-regulation could allow China to overtake the U.S. in the technological race.

The shift toward self-governance is facing pushback from experts at the World Summit AI in Amsterdam and other industry insiders who believe formal regulation is the only viable answer. These critics suggest that voluntary accords are insufficient to manage the systemic risks associated with AI, contrasting with the White House's focus on competitive speed.
